race.comment: Consistent filly INHABIT (12) last raced four weeks ago when a tiring fourth over 1100m on the outer circuit. Placed at all three runs over today's journey. Takes on older horses this time but looks well treated after the claim and from a good gate will be given every chance. ZATANNA (8) has her hoof firmly on the till. Led and looked the winner only to be nailed on the line last time out over 1100m at Clare. Has the gate speed to neutralise the wide draw. Hard to toss coming back a little in distance off a six-day back-up. MADAM JEANETTE (7) appreciated the drop in grade when a narrow winner recently over 1100m at Gawler. Speedy mare with a decent record here at 1000m. Nice each-way option. MAJOR RUMBLE (1) resumes. Will find this a bit short but can storm home into a top four finish without surprising.
